title: WPMS/1983/2019 of USHA UNIYAL SHARMA Vs COMMISSIONER PAURI GARHWAL DIVISION CAMP AT DEHRADUN

paras.text:
WPMS No.1983 of 2019
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.

Mr. Bhupesh Kandpal, Advocate, for the petitioner.
 Mr. Suyash Pant, Brief Holder, for the
State/respondent no.1.
 Mr. Prabhat Bohra, Advocate, holding brief of Mr.
Rahul Consul, Advocate, for the respondent no.2.
 Evidently unauthorized construction which has been
raised by the petitioner was asked to be demolished by the
"Mussoorie Dehradun Development Authority" vide order
dated 20.11.2017. Against this order, the petitioner
approached before the Appellate Authority which is a
Divisional Commissioner, which was also dismissed vide
order dated 04.01.2018. Now again the "Mussoorie
Dehradun Development Authority" has passed the
demolition order dated 14.06.2019. Aggrieved, the petitioner
has filed the present writ petition.
 The case of the petitioner is that the earlier appeal
was dismissed in the absence of the counsel for the
petitioner and she has no knowledge of it and now she has
already filed a restoration application before the
Commissioner Court, (Camp Court at Dehradun) on
25.06.2019.
 In case, this is so, let the same be decided in
accordance with law.
Under these facts and circumstances of the case, no
interference is being called for by this Court in the matter.
The writ petition stands dismissed.
 Moreover, the petitioner also has a statutory remedy
to file a revision before the State Authorities under Section
7-B (4) of the Uttarakhand Urban and Country Planning and
Development Act, 1973 which the petitioner can avail.
 Let a certified copy of this order be supplied today
itself on payment of usual charges.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
 11.07.2019
Nitesh/
